I was able to bridge a 6 year gap between my father and I when I realized that him and I were both ignoring the actual message to focus on the words used. It's a really weird case of cognitive dissonance for me (amplified by the fact that I know what it is). I can distinguish between a lot of synonyms and explain the differences, but I also am realizing those differences don't matter so much.
